title: Veterinary Office Practice
description: Principles and practice of veterinary office management. Includes client relations, front office skills, and practice management skills. State and federal laws as they apply to veterinary practice. Intended for students in the Veterinary Technology Program; enrollment is limited to students accepted in the program.
outcomes: Demonstrate a basic understanding of practice management.
Recognize and discuss their own personal strengths and weaknesses in interpersonal communication in the veterinary workplace.
objectives: Discuss principles of personnel, facilities, and inventory management
Describe a variety of marketing, promotion, and sales techniques
Discuss and identify forms of harassment
Discuss state and federal laws governing the veterinary field
content: Principles of personnel management, and skills and personal characteristics of good managers
Procedures for hiring and firing employees: job descriptions, interviews, evaluations
Medical records and practice management software
State and federal laws governing the workplace
